::: {#def-bias}
#### Bias

The **bias** of an estimator $\hparam$ for an estimand $\param$ is the
expected value of the [estimation error](#def-estimation-error) [@wikipedia_bias_of_an_estimator]:

$$\bias{\hparam} \eqdef \E{\erf{\hparam}}$$ {#eq-bias-def}

Source: @wikipedia_bias_of_an_estimator.
:::
